newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint unchanged on dollar, cenbank active.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint unchanged on dollar, cenbank active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed unchanged against the dollar on Tuesday and players sold dollars to the central bank throughout the day.
The forint closed at 162.20/25, just off the National Bank of Hungary bid of 162.10 and unchanged from its mid-day close.
Traders attributed the forint's strength to big commercial orders and foreign purchases of equities on Budapest's booming stock exchange, which has surged to new highs in the new year.
"Hungarian equities are rallying and a lot of foreign money is coming in," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank.
Currency trading also perked up in the futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), which saw turnover of 3.78 billion forints, more than double Monday's level.

The Swiss franc was most active with prices mixed. Ecu rose for February and September, the mark fell for March, September and December and the dollar fell for September and March. Sterling and yen were up.
